rules.name: Building for the Future
rules.description:
Each time an Alexandria model is removed as a casualty, choose and apply one of the following options:

*Add 1Red to the Strategy Pool for the round.
*Assign a +1 Action counter to one friendly model.

rules.name: Remake the World (Special Order)
rules.description: Rick may spend SP to nominate friendly Alexandria or Atlanta Camp models in line of sight (at a rate of 1SP per model, to a maximum of 3 per round). That model immediately chooses a new Survivor Type. The new Type is used instead of the old one until the end of the round.

rules.name: One Step Ahead
rules.description: When a friendly model in Rick's Kill Zone is removed as a casualty, he may choose to add 1White SP to the strategy pool instead of 1Red for the Building for the Future rule.

rules.name: 9mm Pistol
rules.description: If attack roll scores one or more !, add 1Red to the roll.

rules.name: Pinpoint Accuracy
rules.description: Andrea may spend 1SP when performing a ranged attack to add one automatic !.

rules.name: Double-Dealer
rules.description: When Spencer is targeted by a ranged attack, roll 1Black. On a Shield, choose a friendly model in his Kill Zone to take the attack on his behalf, even if it was not in range or line of sight. If the target model is wounded, Spencer may immediately spend 1SP to add 1Red to his Defense for the rest of the round.

rules.name: Negotiation
rules.description: Once per round, Aaron may spend 1SP to target one enemy Survivor and one friendly Survivor both within 6. Roll 1Black: on a Shield, the target enemy must lose 1 action in its next activation, and the target friendly model gains a +1 Action counter.

rules.name: Good Neighbor
rules.description: If a friendly model within Heath's Kill Zone is wounded by an enemy attack, both Heath and that model add 1White to their Defense for the remainder of the round.
